subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
Two logical functions: 
 
f1 (A, B) = Σ(1, 2) 
 
f2(A, B) = Σ (0, 1, 3) 
 
then output f(A, B) will be 
 
 
 
 
 
(a) Σ(1, 2) 
(b) Σ(0, 1, 3) 
 
(c) Σ(0, 1, 2, 3) 
(d) Σ(1) 
 
[MCQ]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-07 (Mux, Encoder, Decoder).
